title: MartinezPeon2024: Kinesthetic motor imagery at graded force levels
description: EEG recordings of kinesthetic motor imagery of a right-hand ball squeeze at three graded force levels (10%, 40% and 70% of maximal voluntary contraction) from 10 healthy participants. Data were acquired with a 14-channel Emotiv EPOC headset at 128 Hz, with five 5-second imagery cues per 40-second recording. The dataset supports characterization and classification of motor imagery force levels for brain-computer interface research. The associated paper (Journal of Neural Engineering, 2024) is by Martinez-Peon, Garcia-Hernandez, Benavides-Bravo and Parra-Vega.
methods_description: Ten healthy subjects performed cue-based kinesthetic motor imagery of a right-hand ball squeeze at 10/40/70% MVC in a single session of 6 runs. Each 40 s recording contained five 5 s cues, and each force level was recorded twice per subject. EEG was recorded with a 14-channel Emotiv EPOC (saline wet electrodes, 128 Hz, P3/P4 reference).
